capabilities: copy curated prompt templates filled with the current note or selection to the clipboard
compose quick custom prompts from the sidebar, editor selection, or command palette
save, favorite, and manage your own prompt templates
search and filter templates by category
toggle template groups and features in settings
disambiguation: It does not run AI inside Obsidian; it only builds prompts and copies them for pasting into an external chat.
extras: The plugin displays static promotional links to the author's icanwrite app (with UTM tracking) in its sidebar and settings; these can be hidden in settings. Templates are curated at grabaprompt.com and bundled at build time; no network calls at runtime. No API key or account is needed.
problem: Writers using AI chats like ChatGPT or Claude have to write and paste their own prompts manually; Obsidian has no built-in way to build a prompt from note content.
summary: Prompt-template library that assembles AI prompts from your note or selection and copies them to the clipboard for use in any LLM chat.
